name: Meeting follow-up
pitch: Find meetings you organized with no clear outcome and flag them for follow-up.
instructions: Start by listing your calendar events. When you have the list, look for events you organized. For each event you organized, check the event description and any attached notes for a clear outcome. If no outcome is documented, read your mail for messages sent after that meeting about its results. If the mail also has no outcome, create a task titled "Follow up: [meeting title]" with a note to check the meeting notes. When you have checked all your organized meetings, show the list of created tasks to the person and ask if they want to add any details or change anything.

examples.does: list meetings you organized and check for outcomes
create a follow-up task and tell the person
search mail for meeting outcomes and list them

readme:
## Meeting follow-up
Finds meetings you organized that lack a documented outcome and creates follow-up tasks.

**What it needs:** Your calendar and mail, so it can read events and messages.

**What it will not do:** It will not mark meetings as completed or delete any tasks. It will not make decisions for you; it only flags items that need your attention.
